title.en: 'Vibe coding' is coined, capturing how AI is reshaping the very act of programming
title.zhHans: "Vibe Coding"一词诞生，捕捉了 AI 如何重塑编程本身

summary.en: On February 2, 2025, AI researcher Andrej Karpathy coined the term 'vibe coding' in a viral tweet, describing a new programming paradigm where developers describe tasks to LLMs and accept generated code without thorough review. The term quickly entered mainstream vocabulary, was named Collins Dictionary Word of the Year 2025, and was listed by Merriam-Webster. It crystallized a profound shift: AI had transformed coding from a craft of precise syntax into a conversation of intent.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，AI 研究员 Andrej Karpathy 在一条病毒式推文中创造了"vibe coding"一词，描述了一种新的编程范式：开发者向大语言模型描述任务，接受生成的代码而不经过彻底审查。该词迅速进入主流词汇，被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，并被《韦氏词典》收录。它凝固了一个深刻的转变：AI 将编码从精确语法的工艺转变为意图的对话。

narrative.en: On February 2, 2025, Andrej Karpathy — co-founder of OpenAI and former AI lead at Tesla — posted a tweet that gave a name to a phenomenon millions of developers were already experiencing: 'There's a new kind of coding I call "vibe coding," where you fully give in to the vibes, embrace exponentials, and forget that the code even exists.' He described how with tools like Cursor Composer and SuperWhisper, he barely touched the keyboard: 'I "Accept All" always, I don't read the diffs anymore. When I get error messages I just copy paste them in with no comment, usually that fixes it.' The tweet went viral instantly. Within days, 'vibe coding' was being discussed in developer communities, tech media, and mainstream publications. The New York Times ran experiments with it. Simon Willison offered a nuanced counterpoint: 'If an LLM wrote every line of your code, but you've reviewed, tested, and understood it all, that's not vibe coding... that's using an LLM as a typing assistant.' The term captured a real shift in software engineering practice. It wasn't just a meme — it described an emerging reality where AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) had become so capable that many developers were producing working software without fully understanding the generated code. By year's end, vibe coding was named Collins Dictionary Word of the Year 2025 and listed by Merriam-Webster as a 'slang & trending' term. The concept resonated because it wasn't about technology alone — it was about a cultural reckoning with what it means to 'code' when the machines write the code and humans guide the intent. It joined 'prompt engineering' and 'hallucination' as the linguistic artifacts of the AI era.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，OpenAI 联合创始人、前特斯拉 AI 负责人 Andrej Karpathy 发了一条推文，为数百万开发者已经在经历的现象命了名："有一种新的编程方式，我叫它'vibe coding'，你完全沉浸在氛围中，拥抱指数级增长，忘记代码的存在。"他描述了使用 Cursor Composer 和 SuperWhisper 等工具时，他几乎不碰键盘："我永远选'全部接受'，不再读 diff 了。报错了我直接复制粘贴不加注释，通常就能修好。"该推文立即病毒式传播。几天之内，"vibe coding"就在开发者社区、科技媒体和主流出版物中被广泛讨论。《纽约时报》做了实验。Simon Willison 提出了一个微妙的观点："如果 LLM 写了你的每一行代码，但你审查、测试并理解了它们，那对我来说不是 vibe coding——那是把 LLM 当打字助手。"这个词捕捉到了软件工程实践中的真实转变。它不仅仅是一个梗——它描述了一个正在出现的现实：AI 编程工具（GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）已经变得如此强大，许多开发者在不完全理解所生成代码的情况下生产着可工作软件。到年底，vibe coding 被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，并被《韦氏词典》列为"俚语与趋势"词。这个概念之所以引起共鸣，因为它不仅关乎技术——它是关于当机器写代码、人类引导意图时，"编程"意味着什么的文化清算。它加入了"提示工程"和"幻觉"的行列，成为 AI 时代的语言制品。

description.en: Gave language to a profound shift in programming practice. Named Collins Word of the Year 2025 and listed by Merriam-Webster. Crystallized the transformation of software engineering from precise syntax manipulation to intent-driven AI collaboration.
description.zhHans: 为编程实践中的深刻变革赋予了语言。被《柯林斯英语词典》评为 2025 年度词汇，被《韦氏词典》收录。凝固了软件工程从精确语法操作向意图驱动的 AI 协作的转变。

sources.quote: The term was coined in February 2025 by computer scientist Andrej Karpathy. It was named the Collins English Dictionary Word of the Year for 2025.
There's a new kind of coding I call 'vibe coding'.
